ops.entry: WHEN a signed task's intent prescribes text its own verify gate rejects DO let the gate win on substance and ledger the deviation through plan-merge.py record-amendments, with a one-entry digest the main session authors under a recorded ruling — never amend, never a plan edit.
ops.why: Signed intent dictated an index ruling two words over the word cap its own verify enforces; the deviation was ledgered this way. The playbook names record-amendments only for an engineering lead's build digest, not for a conflict found outside a build run.

ops.entry: WHEN a plan run closed FAIL and its findings were accepted as applied at signature DO record the regate judgement naming that run immediately after the signature — every later run-start, whatever its squad, is refused until that judgement exists.
ops.why: The FAIL plan run blocked the next run-start until a regate judgement named it; the playbook ties regate to the validate fix loop only, so the block surfaced late at the first validate start.
